issues.title: Fix Coordinator DX Friction
notes: Findings L39-L42 from docs/design/dogfooding-learnings.md, captured during DOCS-S1 dogfooding run.

issues.title: Fix install-skills to write flat skill files loadable by Skill tool
issues.dod: arm install-skills writes a flat <name>.md file (SKILL.md body) alongside each role skill directory. All four role skills load via Skill tool without error after install. Existing directory structure preserved for references.
notes: See L39 in dogfooding-learnings.md. Affects armature-coordinator, armature-worker, armature-planner, armature-auditor.
acceptance: After arm install-skills, .claude/skills/armature-coordinator.md exists as a flat file
Skill tool can invoke armature-coordinator by name without error
All four role skills have flat .md counterparts after install

issues.title: Add --parent filter flag to arm ready
issues.dod: arm ready --parent STORY-ID returns only ready tasks whose parent chain includes STORY-ID. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged (all ready tasks returned).
notes: See L40 in dogfooding-learnings.md. Without this, coordinators must filter 25+ tasks manually when working a single story.
acceptance: arm ready --parent DOCS-S1 returns only DOCS-S1 tasks when that story is active
arm ready without --parent returns all ready tasks as before
Flag documented in arm ready --help output

issues.title: Deduplicate same-worker serial claim overlap notes
issues.dod: When the same worker claims tasks with overlapping scope serially, overlap dismissal notes are written at most once per issue-pair per claim session. Deduplication applies only to same-worker notes; multi-worker overlap warnings are unchanged.
notes: See L41 in dogfooding-learnings.md. Pre-claiming 4 tasks produced 5 identical notes on one task.
acceptance: Claiming 4 tasks with overlap as the same worker produces at most 1 overlap note per overlapping pair
Multi-worker overlap warnings still fire and are not deduplicated

issues.title: Add DAG hygiene mandate to all bundled agent skills
issues.dod: Each role skill gains a DAG Hygiene section: arm validate and arm doctor must exit clean repo-wide at all times. Warnings from other stories must be resolved, not ignored. Analogy: DAG decay is as unacceptable as failing tests. The --scope flag is for focused review only.
notes: See L42 in dogfooding-learnings.md. Also captures the design decision: unscoped arm validate showing other-story warnings is by design (DAG-wide hygiene), not a bug to fix.
acceptance: Each skill SKILL.md contains a DAG Hygiene section
Section states arm validate and arm doctor must exit clean at all times
